summary: Verified the already-committed T5 calendar import flow (canCreateEvents helper, per-card Import ICS action, IcsImportDialog with validation/pending/success/safe-error/Escape/focus/access-change behavior, CSS, and all six approved component tests) against every acceptance criterion, confirmed the packet verification and full frontend suite pass, and recorded completion in docs/plans/ics-import/00-status.md and the ics-import-t5 task manifest.
follow_up: T6 (E2E + docs) is now unblocked on the T5 side and still waits on T3
important_context: The T5 implementation, CSS, and component tests already existed in commit f8c39b9 (Codex/ics import #2); this run audited them against the acceptance criteria and recorded completion — no source code changes were needed

E2E selectors for T6: trigger button aria-label 'Import ICS to {calendar name}', dialog accessible name 'Import ICS to {calendar name}', file input label 'ICS file', submit button 'Import' (pending 'Importing…'), success text '{n} events imported', acknowledge button 'Done', close button 'Close import'
docs/plans/ is gitignored in the happening repo, so 00-status.md is a local-only canonical status file
Access-change detection treats 401/403/404/409 from any CalendarApiError (including IcsImportApiError) as a stale-access signal that closes the dialog and refreshes the calendar list
